name: POISE-3
question: Does perioperative intravenous tranexamic acid reduce major bleeding without exceeding a prespecified cardiovascular safety margin after noncardiac surgery?

design.population: 9,535 patients undergoing noncardiac surgery with bleeding and cardiovascular risk factors.
design.description: Multicenter randomized bleeding-superiority and cardiovascular-noninferiority trial
design.locator: PubMed abstract, Methods and Results; Tikkinen 2026 PubMed abstract, Methods

verdictNote: Bleeding superiority was met; cardiovascular noninferiority was not established.
takeaway: In noncardiac surgery, intravenous tranexamic acid reduced the 30-day composite of life-threatening, major, or critical-organ bleeding versus placebo; the prespecified noninferiority margin for the cardiovascular composite was not met.

reports.label: Primary tranexamic-acid report
reports.citation: Devereaux PJ, Marcucci M, Painter TW, et al. "Tranexamic Acid in Patients Undergoing Noncardiac Surgery." *N Engl J Med.* 2022;386(21):1986-1997. doi:10.1056/NEJMoa2201171

results.measure: Life-threatening, major, or critical-organ bleeding by 30 days
results.note: Absolute risk difference −2.6 percentage points (95% CI −3.8 to −1.4); two-sided superiority test.

results.measure: Myocardial injury, nonhemorrhagic stroke, peripheral arterial thrombosis, or symptomatic proximal VTE by 30 days
results.note: Noninferiority required a one-sided 97.5% CI upper bound below 1.125 and one-sided P <0.025; observed upper bound 1.14. P is one-sided for noninferiority. Absolute risk difference 0.3 percentage points (95% CI −1.1 to 1.7).

delivery.label: Tranexamic-acid dosing
delivery.value: 1 g intravenous bolus at the start and 1 g at the end of surgery; placebo at the same times.

reports.label: Prespecified urologic subgroup
reports.citation: Tikkinen KAO, Marcucci M, Halme ALE, et al. "Safety and Efficacy of Tranexamic Acid in Urologic Surgery: Results from the International, Randomized, Placebo-Controlled POISE-3 Trial." *Eur Urol.* 2026;90(2):140-149. doi:10.1016/j.eururo.2026.03.019

results.note: Prespecified subgroup analysis; confidence interval includes 1.
